reddit.title: Introducing New Features in Provincia: Let Your Colony Speak!
reddit.body: We're excited to share some new features that will enhance your gameplay experience in Provincia. Our latest update introduces thought badges for settlers, a problem-alert stack for immediate feedback, and a compact stats panel that keeps you informed without interrupting your play. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

posts: Provincia is evolving! Discover how your colony can now communicate its needs and issues with our new features. Learn more: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

Your settlers can now express their needs with thought badges! Plus, stay informed about problems in real-time with our new alert system. Read all about it: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

steam.title: Provincia Update: Your Colony Speaks!
